name: keepalived
readme_excerpt: Load balancing & high availability for Linux Website · Documentation · Download · Quick Start · Community Keepalived is a routing software written in C. It brings simple and robust load balancing and high availability to Linux systems and Linux based infrastructures, and it runs in production across data centers, ISPs and hardware vendors worldwide.
